# Second Opinion — what the manufacturer admitted, and what owners report

> Paste a VIN. You get the open safety recalls for that vehicle, and the faults owners
> keep filing complaints about that were never recalled. The gap between the two is what
> is worth inspecting before buying. Built for the ALBA CARS engineering assessment.

Data comes from NHTSA's public vPIC, recalls and complaints APIs. Nothing is stored; the
app holds a short-lived cache and no user data.

## Pages

- [Home](https://alba-second-opinion.vercel.app/): VIN lookup. State is in the query string, so a filtered view is a shareable link.

## Source and documentation

- [Repository](https://github.com/novaxertz/alba-cars-assessment): all three assessment projects.
- [README](https://github.com/novaxertz/alba-cars-assessment/blob/main/01-web-app/README.md): what it does, the upstream quirks, how to run it.
- [Build log](https://github.com/novaxertz/alba-cars-assessment/blob/main/01-web-app/BUILD_LOG.md): decisions, bugs and known limitations.
